visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-width promotional hero slider at the top of the home page
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width red (#E21E2D) band, 3 swiper slides: white uppercase H1, paragraph, white pill CTA with icon, small legal disclaimer; product image fills right half; dot pagination.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = image only; cell 2 = heading, paragraph, CTA link, optional small-print disclaimer paragraph(s) after the CTA
contentPattern.description: Rotating interactive slider of 3 promo slides with image + text; carousel is an interactive component. Background colour belongs to the hero carousel itself, so no section metadata.

usage: Top-of-page promo slider with 1-n slides. Dot pagination is shown when there are 2+ slides.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width image + text promo slides. For several cards visible at once use carousel-offers; for centred peeking slides use carousel-campaigns.
